name: ANSI/IEEE off-delay normally-closed contact symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for off-delay normally-closed contact, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The off-delay NC contact form identifies instant opening on operation and a delayed return to the documented closed state. The circuit remains interrupted during the specified release interval, with supply-loss handling defined by the timer product.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Identify which transition is delayed rather than assigning delay to both directions.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Contact polarity and timing direction are independent aspects of the output definition.
